q-spell-correct.label: Pick the correct spelling
q-spell-correct.summary: Four spellings of one word; only one is right.

q-spell-misspelt.label: Find the misspelt word
q-spell-misspelt.summary: Four different words; one of them is spelt wrongly.

rules.text: A prefix joined to a root keeps every letter of both: dis + appear = disappear (one s, two p), un + necessary = unnecessary (two n). Words such as accommodate, embarrass and occurrence carry two double letters each.
I before e, except after c, when the sound is 'ee': believe, achieve, receive, ceiling. Learn the exceptions: weird, seize, leisure, height, foreign, neighbour.

There is no dependable rule for -ance/-ence or -ant/-ent, so learn the word. Memory aids: independent, intelligence, existence, experience and conscience take e; appearance, acquaintance, maintenance, perseverance and relevant take a.

Words from a base keep the base's letters: sacrilege gives sacrilegious (the i is added after leg-i, not dropped), religion gives religious. But mischievous has no i after v: it has three syllables, mis-chiv-ous.
Only one English word ends in -sede: supersede. Exceed, proceed and succeed end in -ceed; every other word of this family ends in -cede (precede, recede, concede, secede).
Say the word slowly, one syllable at a time, and write every syllable you say: Feb-ru-ar-y, lib-rar-y, gov-ern-ment, en-vi-ron-ment, Wed-nes-day, par-lia-ment, knowl-edge.

In a find-the-misspelt-word question, read each option letter by letter against the rules; the odd one out is usually wrong because of a double letter, an ie/ei swap, an a/e vowel, or a missing or extra syllable.
rules.ok: Check doubles, then ie/ei, then vowels.
rules.bad: Choosing the longest word without checking.

q-spell-correct.cue: 'Spot / identify the correct spelling', often of a long technical term named by a short description.
q-spell-correct.standard: Say the word in syllables; test each option's doubles, ie/ei and vowels against the rules; keep the one that survives.
q-spell-correct.fast: The four options usually differ in one spot. Find that spot and decide only that letter.
q-spell-correct.eliminate: Cross out options that break a known pattern (extra or missing double, ei after a consonant) before comparing the rest.
traps: Options that differ only by one doubled letter.
Long technical words whose root you can split (psycho + pharmaco + logy).
British and American forms: choose the one the paper uses.

q-spell-misspelt.cue: 'Identify the misspelt word' over four words, three of them correct.
q-spell-misspelt.standard: Check each of the four words one by one against the rules; mark the one that breaks a pattern.
q-spell-misspelt.fast: Skim for the usual slips: single letter where two belong (privilege has one l), a missing i (sacrilegious), ie/ei swapped.
q-spell-misspelt.eliminate: Words you know cold go out first; spend your time on the unfamiliar one.
traps: Unusual but correct words (vicereine, defenestrate) look wrong and tempt you.
The misspelt word is often the common-looking one.
